title: Extraction of Stizolophus balsamita subsp. leaves
author: Nawrot, Joanna
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Crush dried leaves
steps.instruction: Weigh 630 g of dried Stizolophus balsamita subsp. leaves and crush them to a fine powder.

steps.title: Methanol extraction
steps.instruction: Soak the crushed leaf material in methanol (MeOH) for sufficient time to extract the constituents, then evaporate the MeOH under reduced pressure to obtain a dry residue.

steps.title: Aqueous partitioning
steps.instruction: Dissolve the MeOH‑derived residue in water, then perform successive liquid‑liquid extractions: first with dichloromethane (CH₂Cl₂) and subsequently with ethyl acetate (AcOEt).

steps.title: Dry and concentrate CH₂Cl₂ extract
steps.instruction: Dry the CH₂Cl₂ layer over anhydrous Na₂SO₄, filter off the drying agent, and evaporate the filtrate to dryness, yielding 15.5 g of residue.

steps.title: Concentrate AcOEt extract
steps.instruction: Evaporate the AcOEt layer to dryness, obtaining 4.6 g of residue.

steps.title: Silica gel chromatography of CH₂Cl₂ extract
steps.instruction: Load the 15.5 g CH₂Cl₂ residue onto a silica gel column and elute with a mixture of CH₂Cl₂ and acetone ((CH₃)₂CO) at a 15:1 ratio, gradually increasing the proportion of acetone. Collect fractions.

substeps.instruction: If any fraction still contains mixtures, re‑chromatograph it on silica gel using either n‑hexane/acetone (1:3 or 1:8) or n‑hexane/AcOEt (1:3) as eluents.
Combine pure fractions to isolate the following compounds:

steps.title: Silica gel chromatography of AcOEt extract
steps.instruction: Apply the 4.6 g AcOEt residue to a silica gel column and elute with CH₂Cl₂/(CH₃)₂CO at a 4:1 ratio, gradually increasing acetone content. Collect fractions.

substeps.instruction: Identify fractions dominated by a single compound and re‑chromatograph them on silica gel using CH₂Cl₂/CH₃OH mixtures with ratios 25:1, then 20:1, then 15:1.
Combine the purified fractions to afford a white amorphous solid (40.4 mg) identified as 3‑(3,4‑dihydroxyphenyl)propyl senecioate 3‑O‑β‑glucopyranoside (compound 8).
– HR‑ESI‑MS (positive): m/z 435.1631 [M+Na]⁺ (calc. 435.1625 for C₂₀H₂₈O₉ + Na), m/z 413.1812 [M+H]⁺ (calc. 413.1806).
